systems.system: Electronic Signature Regulations (Government Notice No. 335 of 2025)
systems.country_label: regulations under the Electronic Transactions Act, 2019, defining international standards ITU-T X.509 (2019) and ISO/IEC 9594-8:2020/Cor 2:2024 for electronic signatures; the captured text states no requirement on public bodies to comply
systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology

note: Names ITU-T X.509 and ISO/IEC 9594-8 only in a definition of 'international standards'; the captured excerpt (regs 1-4) holds no requirement that ministries or government systems comply, no adoption by a standards body, and no ISO/IEC membership.
